name: Jilin Province Xidian Pharmaceutical Sci-Tech Development Co.,Ltd
summary: Jilin Province Xidian Pharmaceutical Sci-Tech Development Co.,Ltd specializes in the comprehensive process of pharmaceutical goods, encompassing their research, development, production, and distribution. Its portfolio features therapeutic drugs addressing conditions such as anemia, mental health issues, cardiovascular ailments, and various cancers. The firm also supplies traditional Chinese medicines and essential raw materials. These medicinal products are available in oral solid forms and as freeze-dried powder for injections. Established in 1993, the company operates from its headquarters in Panshi, China.
